llm_response.reason: The website presents itself as a designer fashion shop, using known brands and celebrity names, but contact and privacy policy links do not resolve and appear non-existent. There is no visible company or owner info, and customer protection statements are ambiguous. The site uses credibility-enhancing tactics typical of scam sites and fails to provide legally required business and privacy details. These combined with the mimicking of legitimate brands indicate the site fits the characteristics of a fake online shopping scam.
